curated-gf-hina-mincho-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab keeps things structured, a slab-serif with open throats. Hina Mincho excels at drama, with ink-heavy stems and hairline connectors, whereas Roboto Slab excels at order (scout and expedition patches, maybe).
curated-gf-iansui-clash-grotesk: Friendly and hand-drawn, Iansui flares its curve ends gently, while Clash Grotesk, a plain sans, keeps its strokes totally unmodulated. Reading flows smoothly, though it's happiest in brief bursts.
curated-gf-iansui-gf-m-plus-1-code: Hand-drawn warmth meets a rigid monospace grid. Personal warmth from Iansui meets technical order from M PLUS 1 Code, better in brief text, say, for a bandcamp page header.
curated-gf-iceberg-gf-piazzolla: Iceberg looks drawn with a marker tip, bold, with large lowercase eyes. Piazzolla steps in with refined, authoritative lowercase nearly matching its capitals, and that loud-versus-composed tension is the pair's real strength.
curated-gf-iceberg-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads clean and modern, a plain sans with steady strokes. Iceberg supplies the marker-drawn punch up top, and the body stays minimal beneath it, so the headline gets all the attention.
curated-gf-im-fell-double-pica-gf-sorts-: Tight, inky, old-press look from IM Fell Double Pica. Sorts Mill Goudy softens that bookish mood with gentle weight changes, a kinder fit for brief reading (a soap bar wrapper, maybe).
curated-gf-im-fell-french-canon-sc-gf-no: Wide exits and a large eye on every e keep this body clear. Noto Sans Khojki delivers that clarity, while IM Fell French Canon SC handles the dignified, sharply contrasted display work.
curated-gf-ingrid-darling-gf-kameron: Short lowercase beneath tall capitals gives Ingrid Darling its relaxed hand, say, on a woodworking shop sign. And Kameron, made for brief reading, lightens its curves mildly toward the ends and refuses to close them.
curated-gf-inspiration-gf-belgrano: Friendly and inviting, Inspiration crowds its small lowercase under big capitals. Belgrano, a serif with open-mouthed curves, gives that hand-drawn heading a traditional anchor, best for a couple of lines.
curated-gf-inspiration-gf-kode-mono: Hand-drawn charm over a rigid monospace grid. Reading Kode Mono feels sparse and precise, its wide spacing and constant stroke built for brief reads, while Inspiration keeps things warm.
